variable_type.title: Variable Type
variable_type.tip: Select the variable type to set

DataConvertProcess.json_convertor.title: JSON String Conversion
DataConvertProcess.json_convertor.comment: Convert input text @{input_data} from JSON to string or from string to JSON format, return converted result @{json_convert_data}

DataConvertProcess.other_to_str.title: Other Format to Text
DataConvertProcess.other_to_str.comment: Convert input content @{input_data} (e.g. numbers, lists, dictionaries) to string format, return converted result @{other_convert_str}

other_convert_str.title: Conversion Result
other_convert_str.tip: Returns the result converted to string

DataConvertProcess.str_to_other.title: Text to Other Format
DataConvertProcess.str_to_other.comment: Convert input text (string) @{input_data} to another format, return converted result @{str_convert_other}

DictProcess.create_new_dict.title: Create New Dictionary
DictProcess.create_new_dict.comment: Create a dictionary and return the created dictionary @{created_new_dict_data}

DictProcess.set_value_to_dict.title: Set Value in Dictionary
DictProcess.set_value_to_dict.comment: Set key @{dict_key} with value @{value} in dictionary @{dict_data}, return updated dictionary @{inserted_dict_data}

DictProcess.delete_value_from_dict.title: Delete Value from Dictionary
DictProcess.delete_value_from_dict.comment: Delete key @{dict_key} from dictionary @{dict_data}, return updated dictionary @{deleted_dict_data}

DictProcess.get_value_from_dict.title: Get Value from Dictionary
DictProcess.get_value_from_dict.comment: Get value @{get_dict_value} for key @{dict_key} in dictionary @{dict_data}

fail_option.title: When Key Does Not Exist
fail_option.tip: Whether to raise an exception or return a default value when key does not exist

ListProcess.create_new_list.title: Create New List
ListProcess.create_new_list.comment: Create a @{list_type} type list, return created list @{created_list_data}

list_type.title: List Type
list_type.tip: Select the type of list to create

size.title: List Length
size.tip: Enter the length of the list to create

value.title: Initial Value
value.tip: Enter the initial value for the list

custom_list.title: Custom List
custom_list.tip: Define list content; separate multiple elements with commas

ListProcess.insert_value_to_list.title: Insert Value into List
ListProcess.insert_value_to_list.comment: Insert value @{value} into list @{list_data} at @{insert_method} position @{index}, return updated list @{inserted_list_data}

insert_method.title: Insert Method
insert_method.tip: Select insert method: append or insert at specified position

inserted_list_data.title: List After Insertion
inserted_list_data.tip: Returns the new list after inserting the value

ListProcess.change_value_in_list.title: Modify Value in List
ListProcess.change_value_in_list.comment: Change value at position @{index} in list @{list_data} to @{new_value}, return updated list @{changed_list_data}

index.title: Position Index
index.tip: Enter the position index to modify (0-based: index 0 for first, 1 for second, etc.)

ListProcess.get_list_position.title: Get Value Position in List
ListProcess.get_list_position.comment: Get position @{get_list_position} of value @{value} in list @{list_data}

ListProcess.remove_value_from_list.title: Delete Value from List
ListProcess.remove_value_from_list.comment: Remove specified value @{del_value} or element at position @{del_pos} from list @{list_data} using @{del_mode} method, return updated list @{removed_list_data}

del_mode.title: Delete Method
del_mode.tip: Select delete method: by value or by index

del_pos.title: Position to Delete
del_pos.tip: Specify single or multiple positions; separate multiple indexes with commas, e.g.: 1,3,5

removed_list_data.title: List After Deletion
removed_list_data.tip: Returns the new list after removing the element

ListProcess.sort_list.title: Sort List
ListProcess.sort_list.comment: Sort list @{list_data} using @{sort_method} method, return sorted list @{sorted_list_data}

ListProcess.random_shuffle_list.title: Randomly Shuffle List
ListProcess.random_shuffle_list.comment: Randomly shuffle list @{list_data}, return shuffled list @{shuffled_list_data}

ListProcess.filter_elements_from_list.title: Remove Multiple Items from List
ListProcess.filter_elements_from_list.comment: Remove elements in list @{list_data_2} from list @{list_data_1}, return filtered list @{filter_list_data}

list_data_2.title: Elements to Remove
list_data_2.tip: Enter the list of elements to remove; any matching elements in the source list will be removed

ListProcess.merge_list.title: Merge Lists
ListProcess.merge_list.comment: Merge list @{list_data_1} and list @{list_data_2} into one list @{merged_list_data}

ListProcess.get_common_elements_from_lis.title: Get Common Elements of Two Lists
ListProcess.get_common_elements_from_lis.comment: Get common elements of list @{list_data_1} and list @{list_data_2}, return common elements list @{common_list_data}

ListProcess.get_value_from_list.title: Get List Value by Index
ListProcess.get_value_from_list.comment: Get value @{get_list_value} from list @{list_data} by index @{index}

MathProcess.generate_random_number.title: Generate Random Number
MathProcess.generate_random_number.comment: Generate @{size} random numbers of @{number_type} type in range @{start} to @{end}, return generated random numbers @{generated_random_numbers}

MathProcess.get_rounding_number.title: Round Number
MathProcess.get_rounding_number.comment: Round number @{number} to @{precision} decimal places, return rounded number @{rounding_number}

precision.title: Precision
precision.tip: Enter decimal places (e.g., 2 rounds to 2 decimal places). Negative values and 0 are also supported (e.g., -2 rounds to the hundreds place)

MathProcess.self_calculation_number.title: Increment/Decrement
MathProcess.self_calculation_number.comment: Increment or decrement number @{number} by @{add_sub_number}, return result @{self_calculation_number}

add_sub.title: Increment/Decrement
add_sub.tip: Select whether to increment or decrement

MathProcess.calculate_expression.title: Mathematical Calculation
MathProcess.calculate_expression.comment: Perform basic math calculation @{left} @{operator} @{right}, return result @{calculation_number}

text.title: Original Text
text.tip: Enter the text to extract content from

extract_type.title: Extract Type
extract_type.tip: Select the type of content to extract

regex_formula.title: Regular Expression
regex_formula.tip: Enter a regex pattern, e.g. [\u4e00-\u9fff] for Chinese, \d for digits, [a-zA-Z] for English

first_flag.title: Extract First Match Only
first_flag.tip: Whether to extract only the first matching result

StringProcess.replace_content_in_string.title: Replace Content in Text
StringProcess.replace_content_in_string.comment: Replace @{replace_type} type content in text @{text} with @{new_value}

text.title: Original Text
text.tip: Enter the text to replace content in

replace_type.title: Replace Type
replace_type.tip: Select the type of content to replace

replaced_string.title: String to Replace
replaced_string.tip: Enter the string to be replaced

regex_formula.title: Replace with Regular Expression
regex_formula.tip: Enter a regex pattern for replacement

first_flag.title: Replace First Match Only
first_flag.tip: Whether to replace only the first matching result

ignore_case_flag.title: Ignore Case
ignore_case_flag.tip: Whether to ignore case when replacing

list_data.title: List Data
list_data.tip: Enter the list data to join

string_data.title: Text Data
string_data.tip: Enter the text data to split

string_data_1.title: First Text
string_data_1.tip: Enter the first text to concatenate

string_data_2.title: Second Text
string_data_2.tip: Enter the second text to concatenate

concat_type.title: Concatenation Type
concat_type.tip: Select concatenation type; custom separator is available

StringProcess.fill_string_to_length.title: Pad Text to Fixed Length
StringProcess.fill_string_to_length.comment: Pad text @{string_data} to length @{total_length} using method @{fill_type}

string_data.title: Text Data
string_data.tip: Enter the text data to pad

total_length.title: Total Length
total_length.tip: Enter the total length to pad to

fill_type.title: Padding Method
fill_type.tip: Select padding method: left-pad or right-pad

StringProcess.strip_string.title: Strip Whitespace from Text
StringProcess.strip_string.comment: Strip whitespace from sides of text @{string_data}, result @{stripped_string}

StringProcess.cut_string_to_length.title: Cut Text to Fixed Length
StringProcess.cut_string_to_length.comment: Cut text @{string_data} to length @{length} using method @{cut_type}, return cut text @{cut_string}

StringProcess.change_case_of_string.title: Change Text Case
StringProcess.change_case_of_string.comment: Change case of text @{string_data} to @{case_type}, return modified text @{change_case_string}

TimeProcess.get_current_time.title: Get Current Time
TimeProcess.get_current_time.comment: Get current time in format @{time_format}, return current time object @{current_time}

current_time.title: Current Time Object
current_time.tip: Returns a time object; use helper functions or conversion actions to output as string

TimeProcess.set_time.title: Set Time
TimeProcess.set_time.comment: Set time @{time} using method @{change_type}, return adjusted time object @{set_time}

TimeProcess.time_to_timestamp.title: Time Object to Timestamp
TimeProcess.time_to_timestamp.comment: Convert time object @{time} to timestamp with @{timestamp_unit} precision, return converted timestamp @{converted_timestamp}

TimeProcess.get_time_difference.title: Get Time Difference
TimeProcess.get_time_difference.comment: Get time difference between @{time_1} and @{time_2} in @{time_unit} units, return time difference @{time_difference}

TimeProcess.format_datetime.title: Output Time as Formatted Text
TimeProcess.format_datetime.comment: Output time object @{time} as text @{format_datetime} in specified format @{format_type}
